faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Still unsure? Our support team is here to answer your questions and guide you every step of the way.
faqs.faq_a_1: Trading – buying and selling in financial markets – is a modern phenomenon and a fundamental economic activity that has evolved over centuries. Trading essentially involves the exchange of goods, stocks, forex, and cryptocurrencies to benefit from market price fluctuations. Unlike investing, which often focuses on long-term growth, trading leverages short-term market movements.
faqs.faq_q_2: How long does it take to master trading?
faqs.faq_a_2: There is no specific time to master trading, but based on the educational plan we provide, we estimate that a student needs 6 to 9 months to acquire skills and information. Mastery depends entirely on market experience and practice (market analysis calls with experts are essential for skill acquisition).
faqs.faq_q_3: How long will it take to complete the training?
faqs.faq_a_3: The trading world is vast, so the amount of information to acquire is immense, and it doesn’t rely on time as you’ll learn something new daily, even over years. Our educational plan estimates two days per lesson: one for watching and one for application and correction.
faqs.faq_a_4: It’s deceptively challenging. One of the most difficult fields to enter, but once mastered, it becomes a transformative life skill. Unlike what you see on social media, trading is not a strategy or even a specific stock or chart pattern; it’s much broader than that.
faqs.faq_q_5: When will I start earning from trading?
faqs.faq_a_5: It’s better to rephrase this question as 'Can I stop losing?' The answer comes after practicing on a demo account (mock account) and once your trainer sees you’re following a specific risk management strategy, they’ll decide when you can start real trading and profit within a defined risk framework.
faqs.faq_q_6: Does your academy offer comprehensive education from basics to mastery?
faqs.faq_a_6: Yes, our academy provides education that begins with Forex basics, then moves to classic technical analysis, fundamental and economic analysis, liquidity analysis, weekly market reviews, and concludes with advanced expertise.
faqs.faq_q_7: Are there any monthly subscription fees?
faqs.faq_a_7: There are no fees for education; it’s a one-time payment. Weekly analysis is provided for a month, after which monthly payment is required to continue receiving weekly and market analysis.
faqs.faq_q_8: Can I learn whenever I want?
faqs.faq_a_8: Yes, calls are recorded, and students can learn whenever they like.
faqs.faq_q_9: Why do most traders lose at the beginning?
faqs.faq_a_9: One of the most important foundations of trading is risk management, which is a core focus in our curriculum. Proper risk management can reduce your losses and increase profit opportunities.
faqs.faq_q_10: What is the minimum capital needed to start trading?
faqs.faq_a_10: No one can define your capital, but you might ask yourself how much daily profit you’d be satisfied with in the Forex market, aiming for 1-3% of the capital.
